findings.title: OpenCode Breach Exposes User API Keys in What Company Calls a Distillation Attack - CySecurity News
findings.summary_md: CySecurity News reported on October 17, 2026 that attackers accessed a legacy system to steal credentials linked to Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google, leaving some users with unauthorized bills. The article describes the breach as tied to a large-scale distillation attack impacting OpenCode Console users who linked external AI providers.

findings.title: OpenCode Breach: What Happened and How to Rotate Exposed AI API Keys - Cyera
findings.summary_md: Cyera's October 17, 2026 analysis confirms OpenCode disclosed a breach affecting 1.4% of Console users with linked external providers, attributing it to a legacy console system being retired. The post advises rotation of exposed AI provider API keys and outlines defender actions.

findings.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys - The Hacker News
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News reported on October 18, 2026 that OpenCode says a Console breach may have exposed AI provider keys belonging to 1.4% of users. The article notes the incident involved unauthorized access and prompted revocation notices for affected external-provider accounts.
